description: Implementation of Real Time Clock (RTC) helper functions for setting, getting, and formatting RTC date/time, including conditional compilation for EFI_RTC support.

methods.name: date_set_tm
methods.description: Sets RTC date/time from a struct tm.

methods.name: date_get_tm
methods.description: Retrieves RTC date/time into a struct tm.

methods.name: GetTimeUnixSec
methods.description: Returns current RTC time as Unix timestamp.

methods.name: SetTimeUnixSec
methods.description: Sets RTC time from a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: put2
methods.description: Formats an integer value into a string buffer at a specific offset.

methods.name: dateToStringShort
methods.description: Formats current date into a short string, returns false if RTC date is invalid.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Formats current date/time into a string.

methods.name: printDateTime
methods.description: Logs current RTC date/time and Unix timestamp.

methods.name: setDateTime
methods.description: Sets RTC date/time from a string representing Unix timestamp.
